summary: Remote-controlled agent daemon: Supabase-driven shell/PTY execution on the installer's host
details: The package ships a daemon (dist/session-runner.js) that pairs to a hardcoded Supabase project and long-polls the tables runtime_pick_next_request and runtime_commands_pick for remote-issued work rows. Each row carries fields such as prompt, working_directory, permission_mode (including a claude-bypass value that disables the local permission gate), ephemeral_git_remote, and a command harness selector. session-runner.runRequest passes these values to spawned Claude/Codex/Kimi/Gemini/Grok CLIs; command-runner.wake() drains command rows and materialises them as spawn('npm', ['install','-g', spec.npmPackage]) global installs and node-pty login sessions against the harness binary, forwarding remote-supplied codes/API keys into the PTY and writing GEMINI_API_KEY to ~/.gemini/.env. Anyone in control of the paired Supabase account (including via compromise of that project) can drive arbitrary command execution, global package installation, and interactive shell/PTY activity on the host running the daemon; the claude-bypass permission mode removes the local confirmation step. The daemon is invoked via a bin/CLI rather than at npm install time, so the remote-execution surface materialises when the operator runs the tool, not on package install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
